model_version: scorecard-heuristic-1.0 (synthetic weights; re-fit on official D1/D2 when available)
output: likelihood (0-100) of a VERIFIED payment within horizon_days, plus intensity and top reasons

signal_notes.sms_delivered: Worth 0 by decision: SMS delivery says nothing about whether the borrower engaged.
signal_notes.responses: Any borrower response on any channel (reply, PTP, answered call with captured response) carries the most weight.
signal_notes.aa: AA/Data Spine signals only where consent exists; absence is neutral (0), never a penalty.
signal_notes.technical_bounce: Balance was sufficient but NACH bounced (mandate/technical issue) - strong signal the borrower will pay.

evidence_strength: share of the 4 signal groups (payment history, engagement, intent, bounce/AA) with at least one non-missing input; reported separately from the score

LOW.channels: cheapest consented channel with evidence of reach (read, click, answer, reply); else cheapest consented; no voice

STANDARD.channels: all consented; IVR allowed; voicebot not

HIGH.channels: all consented including IVR and voicebot

intensity_levels.ceiling_rule: final allowance = min(intensity allowance, K01 policy cap, lender cap, official cap); K09 learning still picks channel, time and whether a touch is worth its cost

override_note: Overrides force WAIT; the score is still computed and logged for analytics.
calibration_plan: When D1/D2 arrive: fit logistic regression on the same features to 'verified payment within 7 days', convert coefficients back to points, keep the same cut-offs unless the persuadable band holds less than 30% of accounts.

low_evidence_cap.rule: if evidence_strength <= 0.5 and intensity is HIGH, use STANDARD
low_evidence_cap.reason: base score 50 sits in the persuadable band, so borrowers with little data would otherwise get maximum effort
